messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: SEV2  Spike in 502/5xx for /v1/embeddings (canary segment). Alert at 2025-11-05T08:08:10Z. Paging alex (oncall).

alex (oncall): Acked. Taking incident. Opening thread for triage and mitigation notes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout event: release/2025-11-05-emb-canary (sha: d4e5f6). Canary ramp to 30% at 2025-11-05T08:07:45Z.

nina-eng: Observing 502 on canary instances. Sample log from canary-1: ```
2025-11-05T08:09:01Z ERROR serve: model init failed: kms:AccessDeniedException: user arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-canary-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/ef12-3456
 at loader.go:182
```

ops-janet: We deployed a KMS alias swap earlier this morning as part of key rotation. New alias is `alias/redwood-embeddings-v2025`. Looks like the canary role never got the new decrypt binding.

sre-liu: I exec'd into canary pod and validated envs: ```
$ kubectl -n inference exec -it canary-0 -- env | grep REDWOOD_KMS
REDWOOD_KMS_ALIAS=alias/redwood-embeddings-v2025

$ aws sts get-caller-identity --profile canary
arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-canary-role/session

$ aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.enc --key-id alias/redwood-embeddings-v2025 --profile canary
An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Decrypt operation: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt
```

emma-support: Impact: about 12 customers saw 502s over the last 6 minutes; most on lower tiers. One churn-risk customer opened a ticket. No broad enterprise impact seen yet.

alex (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Stop canary routing (feature flag / rollout weight -> 0) to restore baseline. 2) Remediate IAM binding for the canary role in infra. 3) Add preflight to key rotation pipeline. Which is fastest?

nina-eng: Flip the feature flag now. That will halt customer-facing failures immediately. We can do IAM fix afterwards.

deploy-bot: Manual action received: set_canary_weight 0 by nina-eng at 2025-11-05T08:11:33Z. Canary weight now 0%.

incident-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate decreasing; re-evaluate in 60s.

sre-liu: Metrics show error rate drop from 2.9% to 0.1% in 3 minutes. Canary instances still running but receiving no traffic.

ops-janet: For remediation: I'll open an infra PR to attach kms:Decrypt for `alias/redwood-embeddings-v2025` to `redwood-canary-role` and update the rotation job to check target principals prior to alias swap.

alex (oncall): Alternative to IAM patch is rolling alias back to previous key but that risks breaking other services that already depend on the new key. Prefer to fix IAM.

nina-eng: Agreed. Plan: keep canary at 0% until PR merges and we do a controlled 5-10% canary. Add a smoke test that tries a sample decrypt in the deploy pipeline.

emma-support: I've created ticket INC-2025-211 and added affected customer IDs. Support will monitor and notify if any high-value customers escalate.

ops-janet: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/pull/450  adds policy attachment and a pre-rotation probe that validates decrypt for a list of service principals. Asking infra/security for review.

sre-liu: I'll add the smoke preflight to the inference CI: run `aws kms decrypt` against test ciphertext using the deploy identity; fail deploy if decrypt fails. Also adding a lint rule in the deploy job to ensure IAM changes for service principals exist before alias swap.

alex (oncall): Assignments: ops-janet -> infra PR + coordinate security review, nina-eng -> smoke + re-run canary when green, sre-liu -> CI gating, emma-support -> customer tracking. Handoff to ops-janet at 2025-11-05T09:05:05Z unless paging needed.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 2025-11-05T09:05:05Z  root cause provisional: key rotation without granting kms:Decrypt to canary service principal. Postmortem requested.

emma-support: I'll draft timeline and customer-facing note if any enterprise partner asks. Will attach logs and affected IDs to INC-2025-211. :memo:

ops-janet: After PR merge we'll run a small canary (10%) for 15 minutes with active decrypt smoke checks. If green, promote to 30% then 100%. Also adding a runbook blurb: always attach policy for new key to known service roles before alias swap.

alex (oncall): Handoff complete. If anything spikes, page me directly. Closing notes in incident tracker and scheduling postmortem.

incident-bot: Thread closed (mitigated) at 2025-11-05T09:05:05Z.
